name: Improve Product Activation
summary: Improve first-use activation by removing barriers to a verified user value event.
description: Review and improve post-signup onboarding around a defined value event, user intent, prerequisites, state transitions, guidance, recovery, and measurement. Use when new users enter a product but fail to reach meaningful value.
refuses: It does not add forced tours, fake progress, nagging, or celebratory friction without user value.
It does not hide required setup, data use, or irreversible actions.
It does not claim activation or retention impact without cohort evidence.
